text:
sarah_sales: FYI BankCo POC blocked — when they set region=eu-west-1 and model=redwood-v2-large (they insist on exact version pin) we get ModelUnavailable. Also they retried and saw 429s. Need SE + infra to triage, plus pricing & security Qs.

devon_se: can you paste the logs / request_id? 429 vs 404 makes a big difference.

sarah_sales: ```json
{"request_id":"req_0a1b2c3d","error":"ModelUnavailable","code":404,"model":"redwood-v2-large","region":"eu-west-1"}
```

Also this 429 snippet after retries:

```
{ "request_id":"req_0a1b2c3e","error":"RateLimitExceeded","code":429 }
```

lucas_reliability: Heads up — redwood-v2-large was removed from the eu-west-1 pool during last catalog cleanup; it's listed as deprecated for that region. Fallbacks: redwood-v2-medium (smaller, compatible), route to eu-central-1 where v2-large still exists, or provision a temporary mirror in eu-west-1 (ops ticket).

anya_security: Flag for PS: BankCo's sec questionnaire requires in-region KMS + audit log retention. Private or Dedicated deployment with customer-managed KMS will be necessary for full compliance. I'll draft answers.

tom_sales_engineer: They also asked pricing for ~300k tokens/day. Need hosted vs dedicated delta. @finance / @pricing — can we get a quick estimate to include in the POC quote? :thinking:

devon_se: Quick workaround options to propose to customer: 1) remove region pin (we can route to eu-central-1 immediately); 2) pin to a compatible variant like `redwood-v2-large-quant` if they accept a quantized variant; 3) request temporary mirror (INF ticket) if they require exact model id.

lucas_reliability: Opened INF-4321 to request temporary mirror of v2-large in eu-west-1 for this POC, assigned to infra-team, ETA ~2 business days.

deploy-bot: INF-4321 created by lucas_reliability: https://redwood.atlassian/INF-4321

sarah_sales: Can someone drop a one-paragraph explanation I can send to BankCo? They want a short reason + mitigation options.

devon_se: Suggested customer note: "The requested model version was removed from our eu-west-1 model pool as part of a regional catalog optimization. We can immediately route your requests to an equivalent variant in an adjacent EU region, or provision a temporary mirror of the exact model in eu-west-1 for the duration of the POC (expected ~2 business days). For in-region key control and audit requirements, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment with customer-managed KMS; pricing will differ — sales will follow up with numbers." :thumbsup:

tom_sales_engineer: I'll follow up with the pricing estimate and add to the quote.

anya_security: I'll attach the KMS + SOC2 answers and the SSO guide to INF-4321.

sarah_sales: thanks all — looping in customer for decision. /cc @BankCo-POC
